gloss_en: "not in order" (shelo k'seder) — the state of reversed/disrupted sequence, typified by the reverse alphabet tashrak and by Chavah as the 'behind' (achor) aspect opposite Adam's 'before' (kedem); experientially, events going contrary to one's will (opposition of will), the root of war and heart-sickness (davai) in LM2:82
